claimsToVerify: Garum was made by fermenting fish intestines in the sun for several months.
Garum factories were banned from operating inside Roman cities due to the foul odor.
Garum was used widely on both savory and sweet dishes.
High-grade garum was expensive and prized by the Roman elite.
